notes.title: Small Bugfix #1
notes.content:
A small but important bugfix for Co's garden:

[list]
[*]Now hoe upgrade can be maxed out.
[*]You can buy Cherry saplings properly.
[*]You can sell Cherries properly.
[*]Fixed a game breaking bug where if you don't have enough money for importation upgrade for new saplings, you could still click the buy button without unlocking a new sapling, therefore softlocking yourself.
[*]Fixed a quality upgrade bug which was not upgrading the value of fruits even if you buy the upgrade.
[*]Fixed some UI elements.
[*]Fixed the House wall.
[*]Fixed the launch problem on MacOS.
[*]And minor optimization improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Co is ready for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
We welcome you to the [b]Steam Next Fest June 2025![/b] This one is a special one for us because Shake it Co! has got a big Next Fest update today. Let's look couple of them:

We changed the parallax background and fences that Co can plant saplings as well. There's some new eco-friendly energy sources in the background that you'll be able to use in the full game:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589386/a3df9800e97d22d1ebb3bc88a42af58ce586e747.png[/img]

Based on valuable feedbacks from our friends and players, we changed the Market UI. Now it's easier to buy saplings and sell fruits:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589386/532d2be17b7dd4190533889220357dde0fb96947.png[/img]

These are just a couple of what we have for the Next Fest! For the full list of new features and bugfixes, we kindly invite you to our website:

[url=https://zerotaskstudios.com/2025/05/29/co-is-ready-for-steam-next-fest/]Full list of new features and bugfixes[/url]

Don't forget to add Shake it Co! to your wishlist and follow us on social media!

- Zero Task

notes.title: Demo Release & Big Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Shake it Co! Demo is Live![/h1]

We released the [b]Shake it Co! Demo[/b] couple of days ago and we're so happy that you can now try it!


[h2][b]Who is Co?[/b][/h2]
Co is this chill dude. He usually waits... for anything to happen. Wanders around. He thinks about things (maybe, we're not sure). But most importantly, he loves his trees. He shakes his trees and gather fruits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589386/4f771524ebaad304123b31909db7bf767b262b4f.png[/img]

Here's the first big update to the Demo:

[h3][b]🐞Bugfixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] ⌨️[b]ESC[/b] key will correctly close menu panels
[*] 🍒[b]Cherries[/b] can be sold correctly
[*] ⚙️Fixed UI elements in the Settings Menu
[*] 🎮Fixed a bug that causes controllers to vibrate uncontrollably.
[*] 💾Save and load system works correctly and now gives an heads up when you save the game
[*] 🚀Remarkable amount of optimizations have been made and more on the way
[*] 📖[b]"How to Play"[/b] panel in the menu can now be closed properly
[*] 🌐[b]"Zero Task Star"[/b] bottom left in the menu is now properly redirects you to our website
[*] 🌳Fixed a game breaking issue that messes up fruit drop rate, tree grow time and fruit count in a tree after loading your game
[*] 🔊Fixed a sound bug which causes some sound levels doesn't change even though you change it.
[*] 🪴Fixed a game breaking issue that prevents you buy new saplings even though you purchased enough importation upgrades after you load your game
[*] 😱Fixed a game breaking bug which causes losing your save data if you quit the game
[/list]
[h3][b]✨New Features / Changes✨[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] ⏱️Base tree grow time [b]40 sec -> 35 sec[/b]
[*] 💰Base importation upgrade cost [b]30 gold -> 25 gold[/b]
[*] ⏳The time interval to disappear for fruits that are not collected [b]30 sec -> 1 min[/b]
[*] ⏭️The beginning intro video is now skippable
[*] 🪴You can now buy more than one sapling at one time
[*] 🧘[b]New Chill Mode:[/b] You can just click and hold and Co will shake the trees!
[*] 🖱️[b]New Clicker Mode:[/b] Turns the game into a true clicker.
[/list]

And that's it for the first week of Demo Release! We are working on Shake it Co! Demo constantly and getting it ready to [b]The Steam Next Fest June 2025![/b]🚨Don't forget to give feedbacks to us using the usual channels below this text.

And don't forget to add the game to your wishlist!

We'll see you next time!

- Zero Task

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3578070/Shake_it_Co/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3209690/808/
